name: Criminal Desires
source:
Step into the shoes of a rising detective in Criminal Desires: BL Yaoi Game, an exciting blend of BL (Boys' Love), crime, and drama. You and your partner are the star duo of your police precinct, tasked with a high-stakes undercover mission: infiltrating a powerful and notorious crime family. But in the dangerous underworld, nothing is as it seems, and trust is a rare commodity. As your loyalties blur, will you prioritize the law or your heart?

With riveting character relationships and an intense narrative, Criminal Desires plunges you into a world of passion, betrayal, and deep emotional connections!

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.blmafia]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
在《犯罪欲望：BL八追游戏》中，扮演一名冉冉升起的侦探，这是一款将BL（男孩之恋）、犯罪和戏剧融为一体的精彩游戏。你和你的搭档是警察局的明星二人组，肩负着一项高风险的卧底任务：渗透到一个强大而臭名昭著的犯罪家族中。但在危险的黑社会里，一切都不是表面看起来的那样，信任是一种稀有商品。当你的忠诚度变得模糊时，你会优先考虑法律还是你的心？

凭借引人入胜的人物关系和激烈的叙事，《犯罪欲望》将你带入一个充满激情、背叛和深刻情感联系的世界！

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.blmafia]Google Play[/url]]
